title: Building an AXI Out-of-Order Scoreboard
description: Build an ID-aware AXI read monitor and per-ID scoreboard, prove them against a reordering, interleaving, stalling responder with error injection and four mutants, then pair AXI4 write data with its addresses.

steps.title: Rebuild reads with one queue per ID
steps.instructions: Complete `on_ar()` and `on_r_beat()` in `axi_monitor.sv`: push each AR into `open_q[ARID]`, publish a separate copy on `req_ap`, append every R beat to the oldest open read of its RID, check RLAST on beat ARLEN + 1, and publish on RLAST. Report `UNEXPECTED_R` for an RID with nothing open; never flag SLVERR or DECERR.

steps.title: Match by ID and account at the end
steps.instructions: Complete `write_act()` and `check_phase()` in `axi_scoreboard.sv`: pop the oldest expected read for the ID, compare with `diff()`, count matches and mismatches, and report every read still expected in `check_phase`.

steps.title: Run clean across seeds
steps.instructions: Compile `testbench.sv` with top `tb_top` and run with no plusargs on several seeds. Each run must end with `SCB_SUMMARY matches=40 mismatches=0 pending=0` and `UVM_ERROR :    0`, although the responder reorders, interleaves, stalls and returns SLVERR.

steps.title: Prove the checks with four mutants
steps.instructions: Run with `+MUTANT=SAME_ID_SWAP`, `+MUTANT=DROP_RLAST`, `+MUTANT=EXTRA_BEAT` and `+MUTANT=WRONG_RID`. Each run must end with at least one UVM_ERROR from the component the README's mutant table names.

steps.title: Stretch: pair AXI4 write data with its addresses
steps.instructions: Complete `axi_wr_pairer` in `write_pairing.sv` (W bursts pair with AWs in order, W may arrive first, WLAST is checked at pairing, B pops the oldest write per AWID), then run `write_pairing_tb.sv` with top `tb_wr_pairing` and expect `PASS=4 FAIL=0`.
